title: Near-real-time engagement notifications and consistent provider star ratings

requirements.summary: Add best-effort near-real-time engagement status refresh and in-app status-change notifications while viewing a provider (preview and detail).
acceptanceCriteria: When a client is on the Provider Preview dialog or Provider Detail page for a specific provider, the UI automatically refreshes that provider’s engagement status without the user manually refreshing the page.

If the provider’s engagement status changes while the client is on the preview/detail UI, the client sees an in-app notification that clearly states the new status in English (e.g., “Provider is now Engaged” / “Provider is now Not Engaged”).
The refreshed engagement status is reflected in the visible status badge/text within 3 seconds of the provider saving a new engagement status (best-effort via polling).
The implementation does not use WebSockets or real-time chat transport; it uses safe periodic refresh (polling) of existing backend query data (e.g., provider preview / provider profile queries).

file_operations.description: Extend provider read hooks to support polling while viewing a provider: allow passing React Query options (e.g., enabled/refetchInterval) to useGetProviderPreview() and useGetProvider(), and ensure polling can be set to ~3000ms without impacting other app-wide query defaults.

Create a small reusable in-app notice/banner component that renders an English message for engagement status changes (e.g., “Provider is now Engaged” / “Provider is now Not Engaged”) and supports dismiss/auto-hide behavior.

When the Provider Preview dialog is open for a selected provider, enable polling (<= 3s interval) of useGetProviderPreview for that provider; detect transitions in preview.isEngaged and display EngagementStatusNotice within the preview experience while also updating the visible engagement badge/text based on refreshed data.

Enable polling (<= 3s interval) of provider details while the Provider Detail page is shown; detect transitions in provider.isEngaged and display EngagementStatusNotice on the page; ensure the existing engagement badge/text area reflects updates from polling without manual refresh.

Add a place in the dialog layout to render an optional engagement status-change notice (e.g., accept a prop or render slot) so the preview dialog can show a clear in-app notification when isEngaged changes while open.

requirements.summary: Show a consistent 1–5 star rating display (with English empty state) across provider card, preview, and detail surfaces.
acceptanceCriteria: Provider cards, provider preview, and provider detail views show a star-based rating display (not only a text/emoji-only rating) when ratings exist.
If a provider has no ratings yet, the UI shows an English empty state such as “No ratings yet” (or equivalent) instead of hiding the rating row entirely.
Any existing job-completion rating flow remains functional and continues to contribute to the provider’s average rating display.
All user-facing rating text is in English.

file_operations.description: Create a shared read-only star rating display component that renders 1–5 stars consistently for an average rating plus an English label; include an explicit empty state (e.g., “No ratings yet”) when ratings count is 0.
Replace the current conditional rating row with StarRatingDisplay so provider cards always show a rating section: star visuals when ratings exist and an English empty state when none exist.
Replace the current emoji/text-only rating display with StarRatingDisplay and ensure the rating row is always present with an English empty state when there are no ratings.
Replace the current single-star icon + text block with StarRatingDisplay and ensure the rating section always shows (including an English empty state when no ratings).
